parameter.memo: Memo update rules: Match table name and field name. If a match is found, update the table memo and field memo; otherwise, leave the memo unchanged.

parameter.closed_by_default: In the Question Count window, control whether the model thinking process is expanded or closed by default.
parameter.embedding_table_enabled_hint: When off, no vector pre-filter — all selected tables are used (recall is a fixed Top-3 and keyword extraction is always on; neither is configurable)
parameter.clarify_enabled_hint: When a question is ambiguous across many tables, pause and ask the user to pick tables before generating SQL
parameter.clarify_table_threshold_hint: Ask only when at least this many candidate tables are in play
parameter.clarify_max_select_hint: Max tables the user may pick in one clarify answer
parameter.clarify_max_rounds_hint: Clarify rounds per question; 1 never re-asks after the first answer, while >1 can ask again while budget remains and accumulates supplements across rounds
parameter.semantic_enabled_hint: When MORE candidates than the cap carry recorded meanings, stuff only the top semantic.max_tables of them into the SQL prompt; recall is a fixed Top-3, so nothing is narrowed at the default cap
parameter.semantic_max_tables_hint: Narrows only when more candidates than this carry meanings; recall is a fixed Top-3, so it only engages at 1–2
parameter.metric_enabled_hint: When an extracted keyword equals a metric's name or one of its aliases exactly, inject its caliber into the SQL prompt and force-stuff its tables
parameter.metric_max_definitions_hint: Max metric definitions injected per question (prompt budget)
parameter.naming_enabled_hint: Inject term → standard-translation pairs whose term/alias equals an extracted keyword or a name/comment of a stuffed table
parameter.quota_max_rows_hint: Maximum rows one SQL execution may return, counted in rows (not characters); the funnel every chat/dashboard/MCP query goes through
parameter.cache_enabled_hint: Serve repeated identical SQL from cache; invalidated by TTL and datasource/structure changes
parameter.cache_ttl_seconds_hint: How long a cached query result stays fresh
